title: Mimikatz LSASS Dump via Process Access
description: Detects lsass.exe process access with suspicious access masks, typically associated with credential dumping tools like Mimikatz.
yaml:
title: Mimikatz LSASS Dump via Process Access
id: f5195e0c-fb94-4d2d-82d2-c4bb21a48c66
status: production
description: Detects suspicious process access to LSASS
logsource:
    category: process_access
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        TargetImage: 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\lsass.exe'
        GrantedAccess:
            - '0x1fffff'
            - '0x1f0fff'
            - '0x143a'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Antivirus and security agents
level: high

title: Suspicious PowerShell Download Cradle
description: Detects command line string combinations indicating PowerShell downloading content from internet resources, common in staging phases.
yaml:
title: Suspicious PowerShell Download Cradle
id: e4596b0c-fa94-4d2d-82d2-c4bb21a48c77
status: production
description: Detects suspicious PowerShell download cradles
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'Net.WebClient'
            - 'DownloadFile'
            - 'DownloadString'
            - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
            - 'iwr '
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Administrative scripts
level: high

title: Remote Desktop Connection from Suspicious Source

title: Remote Desktop Connection from Suspicious Source
id: c1995e0c-fb94-4d2d-82d2-c4bb21a48c99
status: production
description: Detects suspicious network connections on port 3389
logsource:
